checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-capabilities.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -r "$tmp"' EXIT; (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" capabilities --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -q 'Print the machine-readable contract for the whole ao CLI as JSON' "$tmp/help"; "$tmp/ao" capabilities --json >"$tmp/first.json"; "$tmp/ao" capabilities --json >"$tmp/second.json"; cmp -s "$tmp/first.json" "$tmp/second.json"; jq -e '.schema_version == "1.1" and .tool == "ao" and .contract_version == "1.1" and .platform.os != "" and .platform.arch != "" and any(.commands[]; .path == "ao capabilities")' "$tmp/first.json" >/dev/null; set +e; "$tmp/ao" capabilities unexpected >"$tmp/rejected.out" 2>"$tmp/rejected.err"; code=$?; set -e; test "$code" -eq 1; test ! -s "$tmp/rejected.out"; grep -qx 'Error: unknown command "unexpected" for "ao capabilities"' "$tmp/rejected.err"

aliases.reason: The ao capabilities command declares no aliases.

tracker_selection.reason: Capabilities projects the compiled CLI surface and does not select a tracker.

ordered_effects.reason: Capabilities is a deterministic read-side projection with no ordered external effects.
